description.en: The mails your local site sends, caught by the project's Mailpit, in a panel next to your agents. Agents can search and read them to check an order or password-reset email while they test.
description.fr: Les mails que votre site local envoie, attrapés par le Mailpit du projet, dans un panneau à côté de vos agents. Les agents peuvent les chercher et les lire pour vérifier un mail de commande ou de mot de passe pendant leurs tests.

hint.en: The mails caught by this project's Mailpit
hint.fr: Les mails attrapés par le Mailpit de ce projet

tools.name: list
tools.description: Lists the newest mails caught by this project's local Mailpit (id, date, from, to, subject), optionally filtered with a Mailpit search such as `to:client@example.test subject:order`.

query.description: A Mailpit search, such as `to:client@example.test`, `subject:"Votre commande"` or `is:unread`. Leave it out for the newest mails.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Reads one mail caught by this project's Mailpit: headers, text body and the links it holds, to follow a confirmation or reset link while testing.

id.description: The mail's id, as mails_list gives it.

hint.en: Empty: the Mailpit or MailHog service of the project's Lando app, else http://localhost:8025.
hint.fr: Vide : le service Mailpit ou MailHog de l’app Lando du projet, sinon http://localhost:8025.
